{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders and drop rows with missing revenue
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
completed_valid = completed_df.dropna(subset=['revenue_numeric'])

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders with valid revenue
mean_revenue = completed_valid['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Report the number of completed orders with valid revenue
n_completed_valid = len(completed_valid)

mean_revenue, n_completed_valid"}
